output.reason: Lateral ankle inversion injury with swelling, bruising and preserved partial weight-bearing is consistent with a sprain manageable with self-care guidance and a clear action-based safety net.
output.patientMessage: You can start self-care now: rest the ankle, ice it, use a compression wrap, and keep it elevated; over-the-counter pain relief per the label can help. Rolled ankles with swelling and outside bruising are usually ligament sprains. Get in-person assessment today if you become unable to bear weight, or if you develop numbness, coldness, severe worsening pain or rapidly increasing swelling.
